title: damage-world-damage-1997
label: General Glove

won.source: Damage's own Saturday Night Fever, 4 August 1997: General Glove pinned Tom E. Gunn in the deciding fall of a two-out-of-three-falls match.

note: No later document in this record shows a further change; won the title after choosing a championship shot over the still-unclaimed Blood Bash Title at Blood Bash '97 two and a half weeks earlier.

title: damage-world-damage-1997
label: Tom E. Gunn

won.source: Billed champion by Damage's own Blood Bash '97 broadcast (19 July 1997); no document in this record shows the win itself.

how: Lost the World Championship to General Glove in the deciding fall of a two-out-of-three-falls match on Damage's own Saturday Night Fever of 4 August 1997.
note: Won his opening-night regular match's opposite number (Jeff Jacobs pinned him on 16 July) without the title on the line; the reign's own start is not otherwise dated in this record.
